pandas.read_sas

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Load data from a SAS XPORT or SAS7BDAT file.

Call syntax

pd.read_sas(…) Full signature
pd.read_sas(
    filepath_or_buffer,
    *,
    format=None,
    index=None,
    encoding=…,
    chunksize=None,
    iterator=False,
    compression='infer',
)

      Optional
Keyword only

Keyword only

      str or dict

Returns
DataFrame, SAS7BDATReader, or XportReader

    
Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
# Replace the path with a SAS file on your computer.
orders = pd.read_sas("orders.sas7bdat", format="sas7bdat", encoding="utf-8")
print(orders.head(3))
